## s13-v09 — argument map

Anyavedyam aṇumātram asti na: no thing is knowable apart from You. Svaprakāśam akhilaṃ vijṛmbhate: all shines by self-luminosity. Yatra nātha bhavataḥ pure sthitaṃ tatra me kuru sadā tavārcituḥ: where You dwell, make me always Your worshipper. The verse: nothing apart from You is knowable; all shines by self-luminosity; make me Your worshipper where You dwell.

### Open
- Whether 'anyavedyam' means 'knowable apart' or 'known by another' is unresolved.
- Whether 'pure' means 'city' or 'abode' is unresolved.
